note: Windows 用 Impactor 签装 S2Arm 包的分步引导（11-04 维护者 定玩家自装；11-07 维护者 改为随启动器下发原版 v2.7.2，玩家零跳转，第 1 步只在源码树 / 命令行用）。启动器与 pack/jobs/impactor.py guide 共读这一份；按钮名照 Impactor v2.7.2 简体中文界面原文（locales/zh_cn.toml）。错误行的处理办法不在这里写，按 code 取 pack/jobs/errors.py RECOVERY。实测：v2.7.2 缺省设置 → 可用内存 8177 MB。

title.zh-Hans: 用 Impactor 把游戏装到 iPhone
title.en: Install the game on iPhone with Impactor

ok.zh-Hans: 已找到 Impactor {version}（实测过的版本）。

untested.zh-Hans: 已找到 Impactor {version}，但我们实测的是 {tested}；别的版本可能丢掉大内存权限，建议换成 {tested}。
untested.en: Found Impactor {version}, but we tested {tested}; other versions may drop the large-memory entitlement. Use {tested}.

missing.zh-Hans: 没找到 Impactor：S2Arm Windows 版自带它（ThirdParty\Impactor），安装包不完整时重新完整解压；源码树里按第 1 步自己放。
missing.en: Impactor not found: S2Arm for Windows ships it (ThirdParty\Impactor); if the package is incomplete, extract it again. In a source checkout, place it yourself as in step 1.

title.zh-Hans: Impactor 已随 S2Arm 附带（源码树才需要自己下）
title.en: Impactor ships with S2Arm (download it yourself only in a source checkout)

zh-Hans: 打开上面的官方下载页，下载 Impactor-windows-x86_64-portable.exe（免安装版），放到桌面。
第一次双击时 Windows 若提示「已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。
en: Open the official release page above and download Impactor-windows-x86_64-portable.exe (portable) to the desktop.
If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" on first launch, click More info → Run anyway.

title.zh-Hans: 装 Apple 官网版 iTunes（只需一次）

zh-Hans: Impactor 要用 iTunes 自带的 iPhone 驱动；装 Apple 官网下载的 iTunes（不要 Microsoft Store 版）。不需要登录 iTunes。
en: Impactor uses the iPhone driver that comes with iTunes; install iTunes downloaded from Apple's website (not the Microsoft Store version). No need to sign in to iTunes.

zh-Hans: 用数据线连电脑，手机解锁，在手机上点「信任此电脑」并输入锁屏密码。
en: Connect with a cable, unlock the iPhone, tap Trust This Computer and enter the passcode.

title.zh-Hans: 在 Impactor 里登录 Apple ID（只需一次）
title.en: Sign in to Impactor with your Apple ID (once)

zh-Hans: 在 S2Arm 装机页点「打开 Impactor」→「设置」→「添加账号」，输入免费 Apple ID 的邮箱和密码，再输入手机上弹出的两步验证码。
输入前把输入法切到英文；全角字符会被苹果判成账号或密码不对。
en: On the S2Arm install page click Open Impactor → Settings → Add Account, enter your free Apple ID email and password, then the two-factor code shown on your devices.
Switch the keyboard to English first; full-width characters make Apple reject the account or password.

note.zh-Hans: 密码由 Impactor 发给 Apple；Impactor 登录时会连它自带的设备信息服务器（第三方），这是 Impactor 自己的做法。
note.en: Impactor sends the password to Apple; while signing in it also contacts its own device-information server (third party). That is how Impactor works.

title.en: Import the game package and install

zh-Hans: 点「导入 .ipa/.tipa」，选 S2Arm 刚出好的 ipa（资源管理器里已选中它，也可以直接拖进 Impactor 窗口）。
选项页保持缺省，只勾上「自动刷新 [BETA]」；「模式」选「安装」。不要勾「仅注册主程序包」。
点「安装」，等到「完成！」；安装过程中别拔线。
en: Click Import .ipa/.tipa and pick the ipa S2Arm just built (it is already selected in File Explorer; you can also drag it into Impactor).
Keep the defaults on the options page; only tick Auto Refresh [BETA]; set Mode to Install. Do not tick Register main bundle only.
Click Install and wait for Finished!; do not unplug during installation.

note.zh-Hans: 缺省设置会保住「提高内存上限」权限（实测可用内存 8177 MB）。
note.en: The defaults keep the increased-memory-limit entitlement (measured 8177 MB available).

title.en: Trust and open on the iPhone

zh-Hans: 设置 → 通用 → VPN 与设备管理 → 点你的 Apple ID →「信任」。
iOS 16 起第一次打开会提示开发者模式：设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 开发者模式 → 打开，按提示重启。
en: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → your Apple ID → Trust.
From iOS 16 the first launch asks for Developer Mode: Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode → On, then restart as prompted.

title.zh-Hans: 7 天续签不用插线（建议做）
title.en: Renew every 7 days without a cable (recommended)

zh-Hans: Impactor「设置」里勾「开机自启动」，让它常驻；它会在到期前 3 天自动重签，游戏存档保留。
插着线时打开 iTunes → 手机图标 →「摘要」→ 勾「通过 Wi-Fi 与此 iPhone 同步」→「应用」。
手机：设置 → 无线局域网 → 当前 Wi-Fi 右边的 ⓘ →「私有无线局域网地址」设为「关闭」。不关的话电脑在 Wi-Fi 下认不出手机。
en: In Impactor Settings tick Launch on startup so it stays running; it re-signs 3 days before expiry and keeps game data.
With the cable connected, open iTunes → phone icon → Summary → tick Sync with this iPhone over Wi-Fi → Apply.
On the iPhone: Settings → Wi-Fi → ⓘ next to the current network → set Private Wi-Fi Address to Off. Otherwise the computer cannot see the phone over Wi-Fi.

note.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID：每台设备同时最多 3 个自签 App，每 7 天最多注册 10 个包名；删 App 只腾出前者，不退包名额度。
note.en: Free Apple ID: at most 3 self-signed apps on a device at a time, and at most 10 App IDs registered per 7 days; removing an app frees a device slot but does not give App IDs back.

errors.match: Developer API error 1100 / Your session has expired

means.zh-Hans: 保存的 Apple ID 登录过期了：Impactor「设置」里移除账号再添加账号重新登录
means.en: The saved Apple ID sign-in expired: in Impactor Settings remove the account and add it again

errors.match: Anisette error … dns error / os error 11001

means.zh-Hans: 这台电脑连不上 Impactor 签名要用的服务器 mac-ani.jkcoxson.com：检查网络、换 DNS 或开关代理后再装
means.en: This computer cannot reach mac-ani.jkcoxson.com, the server Impactor needs for signing: check the network, switch DNS or toggle a proxy, then install again

means.zh-Hans: 苹果拒绝了这台电脑的登录身份（密码其实对了）
means.en: Apple rejected this computer's sign-in identity (the password was accepted)

means.zh-Hans: Apple ID 或密码不对（含全角字符）
means.en: Wrong Apple ID or password (including full-width characters)

means.zh-Hans: 两步验证码不对或过期

errors.match: An unknown error occured while reading the file / The name for this app is invalid

means.zh-Hans: 旧版 S2Arm 出的包（zip64 或中文显示名），侧载工具读不了
means.en: Package from an older S2Arm (zip64 or non-ASCII display name) that sideload tools cannot read

means.zh-Hans: 这台 iPhone 的自签 App 已满 3 个，删一个不玩的再装
means.en: This iPhone already has 3 self-signed apps; remove one you no longer play and install again

means.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID 7 天内 10 个包名用满，删 App 不退额度；等几天或换 Apple ID
means.en: The free Apple ID used all 10 App IDs for 7 days; removing apps does not help. Wait a few days or use another Apple ID

means.zh-Hans: 手机上已有用别的签名装的 S2Arm（包名相同）：继续用原签名工具更新，或删掉它（先导出存档）再装
means.en: An S2Arm signed by someone else is already on the iPhone (same app ID): keep updating it with that tool, or delete it (export saves first) and install again

errors.match: 9401 / App ID with Identifier … is not available

means.zh-Hans: 包名在苹果那边已被占用；确认登录的是当初装 S2Arm 的 Apple ID
means.en: The App ID is already taken on Apple's side; make sure you are signed in with the Apple ID you first installed S2Arm with
iPhone does not trust this computer
